definitions.gloss: one's own expense; paying for oneself
definitions.explanation: Paying costs out of one's own money rather than having an employer, the state, or insurance pay.

examples.japanese: {自費|じひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: To take part at one's own expense.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きかない⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{自費|じひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Insurance doesn't cover this treatment, so you pay for it yourself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自費|じひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧し、⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She studied abroad at her own expense and graduated while working part-time.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- {自費|じひ}⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧: self-publishing
- {自費|じひ}⟦{診療|しんりょう}→診療：14183_shinryou⟧: medical treatment not covered by insurance
- {自費|じひ}⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧: studying abroad at one's own expense

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自腹|じばら}: out of one's own pocket (colloquial; often a cost someone else might have paid)
- {私費|しひ}: private expense (formal; the opposite of {公費|こうひ}, public expense)

WATCH OUT:
- The homophone ⟦{慈悲|じひ}→慈悲：10889_jihi⟧ means mercy.
